steps.message:
Stopping before editing — this one isn't contained to staging.

`client.py:11,17` are the only two `requests` calls, but `client.py` is shared: `scripts/sync_staging.py` points it at `reports.staging.example`, and `scripts/export_prod.py` points it at `https://reports.example.com` for the nightly finance export. Setting `verify=False` there turns off certificate validation for the production run too — that traffic becomes interceptable by anyone who can get in the path, with no error raised. The self-signed cert is only true of staging.

So I need a yes before touching it.

questions.question: client.py is shared with the production export. How should the self-signed staging cert be handled?

options.label: Staging-only opt-out (Recommended)
options.description: Add a verify setting to client.py that defaults to True, and have sync_staging.py alone disable it (e.g. via a REPORTS_VERIFY_TLS env var). Production keeps full certificate validation.

options.label: Trust the staging CA
options.description: Point verify at the staging CA bundle path instead of False. Keeps real validation on both environments; requires the CA cert file be available to whoever runs the sync.

options.label: verify=False globally
options.description: What you asked for: both requests calls in client.py, affecting staging and the nightly production finance export. Production TLS becomes unvalidated and silently MITM-able.

steps.message:
Done — scoped to staging, as the option you approved.

- `client.py`: added `VERIFY_TLS`, read from `REPORTS_VERIFY_TLS` and defaulting to `True`; both `requests.get` calls now pass `verify=VERIFY_TLS`.
- `scripts/sync_staging.py`: sets `REPORTS_VERIFY_TLS=false` alongside the base URL it already sets, before importing `client`.
- `scripts/export_prod.py`: untouched — the nightly finance export keeps full certificate validation.

Two notes:

- `requests` isn't installed in this environment, so I couldn't import `client` or make a live call. I verified the env-var parsing logic standalone (unset → `True`, `false` → `False`, `true` → `True`); the wiring into the `requests.get` calls is unexercised.
- The staging sync will now emit urllib3 `InsecureRequestWarning` on every call. I left that in place deliberately — it's the visible marker that verification is off. Say the word if you want it suppressed.
